<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="23" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">9:41</text>
    <line x1="325" y1="17" x2="325" y2="22" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="330" y1="14" x2="330" y2="22" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="335" y1="11" x2="335" y2="22" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="340" y1="8" x2="340" y2="22" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="353" cy="18" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="356" y1="21" x2="359" y2="24" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <rect x="369" y="10" width="18" height="13" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <rect x="371.5" y="12.5" width="12" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <rect x="387" y="14" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#121212"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="31" cy="64" r="17" fill="#D4FCBC"/>
    <polygon points="22,64 31,55 40,64" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <rect x="25" y="63" width="12" height="10" rx="2" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <text x="57" y="70" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">mint</text>
    <text x="353" y="69" text-anchor="end" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#5DB329">Later</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Intro -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="111" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Welcome back</text>
    <text x="20" y="138" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Sign in to continue to your food community</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Email field -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="169" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#333333">Email adress</text>
    <rect x="20" y="178" width="350" height="52" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="204" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="35,201 42,207 49,201" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="62" y="210" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">alex.morgan@email.com</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Password field -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="257" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#333333">Password</text>
    <rect x="20" y="266" width="350" height="52" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="291" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="42" y1="284" x2="42" y2="281" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="62" y="297" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">••••••••••</text>
    <circle cx="347" cy="292" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="342" y1="287" x2="352" y2="297" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <text x="370" y="343" text-anchor="end" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#5DB329">Forgot password?</text>

  <!-- Primary button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="360" width="350" height="52" rx="12" fill="#063336" opacity="0.10"/>
    <rect x="20" y="357" width="350" height="52" rx="12" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <text x="195" y="390" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Continue</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Divider -->
  <g>
    <line x1="20" y1="438" x2="164" y2="438" stroke="#E1E4E8" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="226" y1="438" x2="370" y2="438" stroke="#E1E4E8" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="443" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#999999">or continue with</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Google button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="457" width="350" height="48" rx="10" fill="#000000" opacity="0.06"/>
    <rect x="20" y="455" width="350" height="48" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="479" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4285F4" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="48" y1="479" x2="57" y2="479" stroke="#34A853" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="57" y1="479" x2="54" y2="486" stroke="#FBBC05" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="195" y="485" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#333333">Continue with Google</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Facebook button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="515" width="350" height="48" rx="10" fill="#000000" opacity="0.06"/>
    <rect x="20" y="513" width="350" height="48" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="537" r="10" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="48" y="543" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">f</text>
    <text x="195" y="543" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#333333">Continue with Facebook</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Apple button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="571" width="350" height="48" rx="10" fill="#000000" opacity="0.06"/>
    <rect x="20" y="569" width="350" height="48" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="592" r="8" fill="#121212"/>
    <circle cx="53" cy="583" r="3" fill="#121212"/>
    <line x1="48" y1="582" x2="44" y2="578" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="195" y="599" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#333333">Continue with Apple</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Sign up prompt -->
  <g>
    <text x="195" y="663" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">New to mint?</text>
    <text x="195" y="688" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#5DB329">Create an account</text>
    <line x1="139" y1="692" x2="251" y2="692" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="763" width="390" height="81" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="763" x2="390" y2="763" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <g>
      <polygon points="39,779 49,771 59,779" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <rect x="42" y="778" width="14" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="49" y="812" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#5DB329">Home</text>
    </g>
    
    <g>
      <circle cx="146" cy="780" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <line x1="152" y1="786" x2="158" y2="792" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <text x="146" y="812" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Discover</text>
    </g>
    
    <g>
      <rect x="224" y="772" width="17" height="16" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <polygon points="228,788 232,793 236,788" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <circle cx="229" cy="780" r="1.5" fill="#97A2B0"/>
      <circle cx="236" cy="780" r="1.5" fill="#97A2B0"/>
      <text x="232" y="812" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Community</text>
    </g>
    
    <g>
      <circle cx="332" cy="777" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <ellipse cx="332" cy="790" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <text x="332" y="812" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
